name: CG Plumbing Solutions
description:
CG Plumbing Solutions is a locally owned, licensed, and insured plumbing company serving residential and commercial properties throughout the Las Vegas Valley. They provide 24/7 emergency services, planned installations, and new-construction plumbing work, focusing on clear communication, written options, and code-compliant service. The company emphasizes respectful treatment of homes and stands behind its work with a focus on quality and customer satisfaction.

CG Plumbing Solutions is a locally owned Las Vegas plumbing company providing residential, commercial, and 24/7 emergency plumbing service throughout the Las Vegas Valley. The company positions itself around responsive service, code-conscious workmanship, clear options before work begins, and bilingual English/Spanish support.

CG Plumbing Solutions is a licensed and insured plumbing contractor serving homeowners, property managers, businesses, and construction or renovation clients across Las Vegas and nearby communities. The company handles both immediate plumbing emergencies—such as active leaks, drain backups, sewer issues, and water-heater failures—and scheduled repair, replacement, installation, and upgrade work.

Its public-facing service model emphasizes practical, local plumbing help rather than a franchise or multi-office network. The company states that it operates from one licensed, locally owned business serving approved areas throughout the Las Vegas Valley, with service available in both English and Spanish.

The company is associated publicly with Nevada plumbing license C-1D/0093216 and identifies its business contact address as 125 Rosemeade Street, Las Vegas, Nevada 89106.

Core services:

CG Plumbing Solutions promotes a broad menu of residential and commercial plumbing services, including:

24/7 emergency plumbing for urgent leaks, sewer backups, water-heater issues, and other time-sensitive plumbing failures

Drain cleaning and drain repair for clogs, slow drains, backups, and related drainage problems

Leak detection and leak repair, including locating and repairing concealed or recurring water leaks

Water-heater repair, replacement, and installation, including conventional and tankless water-heater work

Repiping and plumbing upgrades, especially for older or deteriorating plumbing systems

Sewer-line and drain-line service, including inspection, repair, and backup-related work

Fixture repair and installation, including faucets, showers, toilets, and related plumbing fixtures

Gas-line plumbing work, performed with attention to applicable safety requirements, code considerations, and manufacturer specifications

Sump-pump service, repair, and installation

Commercial plumbing for local businesses, retail/commercial properties, and property-management needs

Plumbing for renovations and planned projects requiring coordination, installation, repairs, or replacements

Service area:

CG Plumbing Solutions advertises service across the Las Vegas Valley, including:

Las Vegas

North Las Vegas

Henderson

Paradise

Summerlin

Enterprise

Spring Valley

The company’s service-area materials specifically reference residential, commercial, emergency, drain, water-heater, leak-detection, repiping, fixture, and sewer-related needs across these communities.

Positioning and customer value
The company’s public positioning can be summarized as:

A responsive, locally owned Las Vegas plumbing contractor for emergency repairs, everyday service calls, water-heater work, drain and sewer issues, plumbing upgrades, and commercial projects—with bilingual support and licensed, code-conscious service.

Key customer benefits emphasized in its marketing include:

Emergency availability for urgent plumbing situations

Service for both homes and commercial properties

Ability to support English- and Spanish-speaking customers

Local Las Vegas Valley coverage

Licensed and insured plumbing work

Help with both small repairs and larger replacement, repiping, or project-based work

A quote/request process for planned repairs, replacements, and installations

CG Plumbing Solutions is a licensed, locally owned plumbing company serving Las Vegas and the surrounding valley with residential, commercial, and 24/7 emergency plumbing services. From clogged drains, leaks, sewer backups, water-heater repairs, and fixture replacements to repiping, gas-line work, sump pumps, and planned plumbing upgrades, CG Plumbing Solutions helps customers resolve urgent problems and complete long-term plumbing projects with clear communication and dependable workmanship. The company serves Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, Paradise, Enterprise, Spring Valley, and nearby communities, with service available in English and Spanish. CG Plumbing Solutions operates under Nevada plumbing license C-1D/0093216.
